hooks.command: jq -e '.tool_input.model and .tool_input.effort' >/dev/null || printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Set both model and effort on every Agent call. Pick what fits the task."}}'

printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Library, framework and API documentation in this environment comes from Context7 via the find-docs skill (npx ctx7@latest library/docs). Web search and fetch are for everything else."}}'

jq -r '.session_id, (.agent_id // ""), (.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // "")' | { read -r id; read -r agent; read -r p; [ -z "$p" ] || { d="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-guards"; mkdir -p "$d"; printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "$d/$id${agent:+.$agent}"; }; }
jq -r '.session_id' | { read -r id; d="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-guards"; mkdir -p "$d"; [ -e "$d/$id" ] || touch "$d/$id"; }
